answer: Coin-second reward weights make splitting identities neutral. For every block, credit each locked coin once, then divide a fixed reward pool in direct proportion to accumulated weight and round payouts down. Moving stake from umber into whisper and echo cannot multiply its coin-seconds; the operator pays the same lockup cost and earns no extra combined share. This assumes no per-account bonus or concave weighting and no way to count the same coin in overlapping locks. Wealth still buys a larger share.
